The '''solar pike''' was a variant of [[Thyrsian pike]] used for ritual combat by the [[Sun Guard]],<ref name="Ancient Coruscant" /> a feared military unit and [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] that held the [[Pike/Legends|pike]] as a near-sacred weapon. Inherited from the [[Thyrsian]]s' [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] cousins, the [[Polearm/Legends|polearm]] was approximately one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long and was wielded with two [[Limb/Legends|hands]], providing the means to block incoming strikes and attack with the blades on either end of the pike.<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> The solar pike featured conductive tips,<ref name="Ancient Coruscant" /> which were activated through its grip controls and glowed [[Color/Legends|red]]-[[Temperature/Legends|hot]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

==Behind the scenes==
The solar pike was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy at War]]'', a [[2009]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] supplement for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

It was first identified in the second entry of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a twelve-part [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] series presenting cut material from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. The entry was entitled "Ancient [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]," written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] in [[2013]].<ref name="Ancient Coruscant" />
